title: [VIES Integration] Per-environment daily request rate-limit
summary: A per-tenant daily rate-limit of 2000 VIES lookups prevents a single tenant from flooding the shared outbound IP used by Business Central online, which could deny-list the IP for all co-located tenants.
key_points: New table 243 'VAT Reg. No. Lookup Quota' and codeunit 247 'VAT Lookup Quota Mgt.' enforce a daily limit in codeunit 248 before the SOAP call to VIES
The counter resets when the UTC day changes and is shared by all callers, including extensions, job queue and API callers
The 2000 lookups per day cap is about 10x the 99th-percentile legitimate usage and about 10x below the volume that triggers VIES deny-listing
Applies only to Business Central online; on-premises behavior is unchanged
Once the cap is reached lookups fail with an error for the rest of the UTC day; the call hitting the limit logs a security-audit entry and telemetry
